messages:
Ruth C: heads-up: streaming dashboard shows several tenants with effective_sample_fraction ~0.0001 starting 03:12 UTC, reconnect noise started shortly after
Omar N: any recent proxy rollouts?
deploy-bot: streaming-proxy v11.0.1 deployed 03:05-03:11 UTC (canary->100%)
Ivy Z: checking proxy boot logs seeing 'missing mem_pressure' warnings and sampler falling back to hardcoded 1e-4
SRE Oncall: customers filed support tickets about frequent reconnects at 03:20; correlating with the sampling plunge
Ruth C: impact: telemetry undercounted keepalive failures for ~25m, alerts suppressed; we need fast mitigation
Omar N: mitigation plan: 1) flip runtime-config `telemetry.sampler.default_fraction` to 0.02 as a temporary safety net, 2) patch startup to not treat missing mem_pressure as absolute zero, 3) add per-tenant effective_sample_fraction column in console
Ivy Z: applied runtime-config to canary 10% at 03:34 UTC (actor=IvyZ). staging smoke good.
SRE Oncall: will run canary 10m, monitor reconnect-rate, ws.keepalive.sampled_ratio, and sampler.init.err metric
Ruth C: followups: Omar -> PR for safe fallback + tests, Ivy -> runtime-config rollout to prod if canary stable, Ruth -> console alert + tooltip explaining sampling sources
Omar N: will include migration notes for older proxies that don't send mem_pressure. Also adding unit test to ensure missing tag doesn't set fraction < 0.001
Ruth C: thanks all. posting to incidents if customer-impact grows. :thumbsup:
